title: Josh Boone (basketball)
wikitext:
'''Josh Boone''' (born [[November 21]], [[1984]] in [[Mount Airy]], [[Maryland]]) was a forward/center for the [[UConn]] Huskies.  

==High School==
He attended South Carroll High School in [[Winfield]], [[Maryland]], where he averaged 20 points, 14.4 rebounds and seven blocked shots per game. He led South Carroll to a 20-6 record and the state semifinals.  After graduating, he attended West Nottingham Academy (a junior college) in [[Colora]], [[Maryland]], averaging a stellar 28 points, 16 rebounds and 9.7 blocks per game.  

==College==
Boone had a strong career as a freshman in the [[2003]]-[[2004]] season at UConn, starting 37 out of 38 games. He averaged 5.9 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.7 blocks and shot 55.4% from the field. He was also the 12th freshamn to start on the first game of the season under [[Jim Calhoun]]. In the [[Big East]] Tournament, he averaged 8.0 points and 11.3 rebounds in three games. He set a Big East Tournament record for most blocks by a freshman in a game with 16 against [[University of Notre Dame|Notre Dame]]. Against [[Villanova]] on [[February 28]], Boone scored the game-winning shot with 5 seconds left. Boone was also outstanding in the [[NCAA]] [[Final Four]] Tournament, scoring 9 points and grabbing 14 rebounds in the final two games.

==Draft==
Recently, Josh Boone has elected to enter the [[NBA Draft]]. He has hired an agent, thus he intends to take part in the [[June 28]] draft.
